pages.title: Coal Generator
pages.text: Copper, iron, a furnace and aluminum wire. It burns coal and powers nearby machines through wire. It also pollutes, so put a chimney next to it: see the $(l:ecology_inst/page06)Ecology$() section.

pages.title: Machine order
pages.text: $(li)Circuit Fabricator: makes wafers.$(li)Compressor: burns coal and presses metal into sheets.$(li)Electric Compressor: gives twice as many sheets.$(li)NASA Workbench: builds rockets.

pages.title: Tier one wafer
pages.text: Make a basic wafer in the Circuit Fabricator. It unlocks the planet entries and gives you the Galactic Research book, which has the recipes for power, the telescope and rockets.

pages.title: Three kinds of wafers
pages.text: The fabricator takes a diamond, 2 silicon and redstone. The last slot decides the result:$(li)Redstone torch: 3 basic.$(li)Repeater: 1 advanced.$(li)Lapis: 9 solar.$(br2)Advanced wafers go into the Electric Compressor and rockets, solar ones into solar modules.

pages.title: Metal sheets
pages.text: The Compressor presses 2 ingots into one sheet: iron, copper, tin, aluminum.$(li)Steel: an iron sheet and 2 coal.$(li)Bronze: a copper and a tin sheet.$(li)Heavy duty plate for rockets: 2 steel, 2 aluminum and 2 bronze give 2 plates.

pages.title: Power
pages.text: The generator powers machines through aluminum wire. Batteries and the Energy Storage Module keep a reserve. A solar panel runs by day with no fuel or pollution: it needs solar modules, a basic wafer and steel. The advanced one also needs an advanced wafer and heavy wire.

pages.title: What to gather
pages.text: Space eats a lot of metal. Stock up on iron, copper, tin, aluminum, silicon, coal, redstone and diamonds early. Silicon lies deep, so look for it below the other ores.

pages.title: Prelaunch Checklist
pages.text: Tick off fuel, oxygen, parachute and launch pad before takeoff. Crafted from canvas and red dye.

pages.title: Circuit Fabricator
pages.text: Makes wafers from diamonds, silicon and redstone.

pages.title: Compressor
pages.text: Burns coal and presses metal into sheets.

pages.title: Electric Compressor
pages.text: Runs on power and gives twice as many sheets.

pages.title: Basic Wafer
pages.text: Needed for almost every space machine.

pages.title: Advanced Wafer
pages.text: Fabricator: diamond, 2 silicon, redstone and a repeater.

pages.title: Solar Wafer
pages.text: Fabricator: diamond, 2 silicon, redstone and lapis. Makes 9.

pages.title: Compressed Steel
pages.text: Compressor: an iron sheet and 2 coal.

pages.title: Heavy Duty Plate
pages.text: Compressor: steel, aluminum and bronze. The base of every rocket.

pages.title: Aluminum Wire
pages.text: Carries power from the generator to machines.

pages.title: Solar Panel
pages.text: Power by day with no fuel and no pollution.
